DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_PinkLizard:
Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around.
At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years
even humans have become the target of its debauchery.

Produces dubious liquids and items while lounging in <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_PinkLizard:
While fighting together, 
grants the player and <characterName id=|PinkLizard|/> a life steal effect that <Status_Keyword>restores</> <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> of damage dealt as <uiCommon id=|COMMON_STATUS_HP| style=|Status_Keyword|/>.

Produces dubious liquids and items while lounging in <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
